At 0:01, the perspective changes to a first-person view, showing the player's legs and the ball at his feet as he dribbles past the same man, who reaches out with his hand. The scene transitions at 0:03 to a cutaway shot of a soccer player wearing a yellow and blue uniform attempting a bicycle kick, set against a blurred background of a crowd and stadium seating. Throughout the video, there is a text overlay at the top that reads "POV: YOU ARE NEYMAR" and a watermark in the bottom center that says "DusanFC."
